ref_text: THE EUROPE THEY HAD COME FROM LAY OUT THERE BEYOND THE IRISH SEA EUROPE OF STRANGE TONGUES AND VALLEYED AND WOODBEGIRT AND CITADELLED AND OF ENTRENCHED AND MARSHALLED RACES
text: The Europe they had come from lay out there beyond the Irish Sea, Europe of strange tongues and valid and would begot and citadel and of entrenched and martyled races.
